questions.question: Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2016 season?
questions.explanation: Dané van Niekerk won it in 2016.

questions.question: How many 50+ scores separate the all-time #1 (Yolandi van der Westhuizen) and #2 (Olivia Anderson) half-century makers (combined T20 + List A) in the 08/09 season?
questions.explanation: Yolandi van der Westhuizen: 2 — Olivia Anderson: 1 — a gap of 1.

questions.question: At which ground did Courtney Gounden record their career-best innings (47, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kingsmead stadium, against Badgers on 2022/12/04.
